```{r}
library('R2jags')
source('R/plotting_functions.R')
source('R/color_palettes.R')
birds <- read.csv('data/raw/pigeons/pigeons_by_session.csv')
birds <- subset(birds,dynamic_session==F)
Bl <- birds$resp_left
Br <- birds$resp_right
Wl <- birds$reinf_left
Wr <- birds$reinf_right
Nresp <- Br+Bl
Nreinf <- Wr+Wl
bird = birds$bird_num
#unit = birds$unit
unit = NA
for(b in 1:length(unique(bird))){
	unit[bird==b] <- 1:sum(bird==b)
}
n_birds = length(unique(birds$bird))
n_obs = nrow(birds)
observed <- list(
	Br=Br,Bl=Bl,Wr=Wr,Wl=Wl,
	Nresp=Nresp,Nreinf=Nreinf,
	bird=bird,
	unit=unit,
	n_birds=n_birds,n_obs=n_obs)
unobserved <- c(
	'alpha','beta','lambda','kappa',
	'theta','phi',
	'mu_alpha','sd_alpha','mu_beta','sd_beta',
	'mu_phi','nu_phi',
	'theta_pred','phi_pred',
	'Bl_pred','Br_pred',
	'Wl_pred','Wr_pred',
	'Nresp_pred','Nreinf_pred'
)	
```
```{r}
plot_n_mle <- function(Wl,Wr,Bl,Br,xlimz=NULL,ylimz=NULL){
	if(is.null(xlimz)){xlimz=c(-3,3)}
	if(is.null(ylimz)){ylimz=c(-3,3)}
	ratio_rewards <- log(Wl/Wr)
	ratio_choices <- log(Bl/Br)
	distance <- abs(ratio_choices-ratio_rewards)
	plot(log(Wl/Wr),log(Bl/Br),
		xlim=xlimz,ylim=ylimz,
		pch=16,
		#col=color_ch('F000000',alph=0.5*log(Nresp)/max(log(Nresp))),
		col='#000000',
		cex=0.0005*(Br+Bl))
		#cex=.75)
		#cex=distance*5/8+.35)
	abline(h=0,lty='33',col='blue')
	abline(v=0,lty='33',col='blue')
	abline(0,1,col='orange',lwd=2,lty='22')
	res <- lm(ratio_choices~ratio_rewards)
	abline(res$coefficients,col='red',lwd=3)
	return(res$coefficients)
}
```
```{r,fig.width=9,fig.height=6,fig.align='center'}
par(mar=rep(1,4))
layout(matrix(1:length(unique(bird)),ncol=3,byrow=T))
mle_birds <- vector(mode='list',length=length(unique(bird)))
for(tm in 1:length(unique(bird))){
	wl <- Wl[bird==tm]
	wr <- Wr[bird==tm]
	bl <- Bl[bird==tm]
	br <- Br[bird==tm]
	plot_n_mle(wl,wr,bl,br) -> mle_birds[[tm]]
}
```

```{r,eval=T}

print(head(sort(bayes_bird$BUGSoutput$summary[,'Rhat'],decreasing=T)))
print(head(sort(bayes_bird$BUGSoutput$summary[,'n.eff'],decreasing=F)))
nds <- bayes_bird$BUGSoutput$sims.list
```

```{r}
plot_pred <- function(
  W_ratio_pred,
	B_ratio_pred,alpha,beta,
	Wl,Wr,Bl,Br,...){
	plot(W_ratio_pred,B_ratio_pred,
		xlim=c(-3,3),ylim=c(-3,3),
		pch=16,col='#aaaaaa')
	points(log(Wl/Wr),log(Bl/Br),pch=21,bg='#dddddd',cex=(Bl+Br+Wr+Wl)*0.0005,...)
	abline(h=0,lty='33',col='blue')
	abline(v=0,lty='33',col='blue')
	abline(0,1,col='orange',lwd=2,lty='22')
	indx <- sample(length(alpha),size=100)
	for(i in indx){abline(alpha[i],beta[i],col='#ee000020')}
}
```
```{r,fig.width=9,fig.height=6,fig.align='center'}
par(mar=rep(1,4))

	B_ratio_pred <- log(nds$Bl_pred[,tm]/nds$Br_pred[,tm])

	plot_pred(W_ratio_pred,B_ratio_pred,alpha,beta,

}
```

```{r,eval=T}
pdf(file='results/figures/pigeons_1.pdf',width=6,height=4)
	layout(matrix(1:6,ncol=3,byrow=T))
	par(mar=c(2,2,1,1),oma=c(2,2,0,0),
		tck=-0.03,mgp=c(3,0.5,0),cex.axis=.9)
for(tm in 1:length(unique(bird))){
	W_ratio_pred <- log(nds$Wl_pred[,tm]/nds$Wr_pred[,tm])
	B_ratio_pred <- log(nds$Bl_pred[,tm]/nds$Br_pred[,tm])
	alpha <- nds$alpha[,tm]
	beta <- nds$beta[,tm]
	plot(NULL,xlim=c(-3,3),ylim=c(-3,3))
	points(W_ratio_pred,B_ratio_pred,col='#99999905',pch=16,cex=1)
	x <- W_ratio_pred
	y <- B_ratio_pred
	x_brks <- seq(-3,3,length.out=20)
	y_low <- y_high <- x_mids <- NA
	for(xb in 1:(length(x_brks)-1)){
		qntl <- quantile(y[x>=x_brks[xb]&x<x_brks[xb+1]],probs=c(0.025,0.975))
		y_low[xb] <- qntl[1]; y_high[xb] <- qntl[2]
		x_mids[xb] <-x_brks[xb]+(x_brks[xb+1]-x_brks[xb])/2
	}
	lines(x_mids,y_high,lwd=1.5,col='#888888')
	lines(x_mids,y_low,lwd=1.5,col='#888888')
	#scatter_quantile(W_ratio_pred,B_ratio_pred)
	points(log(Wl[bird==tm]/Wr[bird==tm]),
				 log(Bl[bird==tm]/Br[bird==tm]),pch=16,cex=0.6)
	abline(0,1,lty='42',col='#dd0000',lwd=1.25)
	text(-3,3,paste('Bird',tm),font=2,adj=c(0,1))
	if(tm==1){
		legend('bottomright',legend=c('Data','Posterior Prediction'),pch=c(16,22),
			pt.cex=.8,pt.bg=c(NA,'#cccccc'),col=c('black','#888888'),
			x.intersp=.7,cex=.7,box.lty='blank')
	}
}
	mtext(expression(log(W[left]/W[right])),1,line=0.5,outer=T,cex=0.8)
	mtext(expression(log(B[left]/B[right])),2,line=-0.25,outer=T,cex=0.8)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
pdf(file='results/figures/pigeons_2.pdf',width=4,height=4)
layout(matrix(c(2,0,1,3),byrow=T,ncol=2),widths=c(3,1),heights=c(1,3))
par(mar=rep(0.25,4),oma=c(3,3,1,1),mgp=c(3,.5,0),tck=-.02)
lims_bias <- c(-.1,.3)
lims_sensi <- c(0.4,1.6)
# Joint
plot(NULL,xlim=lims_bias,ylim=lims_sensi)
mtext('Bias',1,line=1.75)
mtext('Sensitivity',2,line=1.75)
for(br in 1:length(unique(bird))){
	points(nds$alpha[,br],nds$beta[,br],pch=16,cex=.5,col='#aaaaaa05')
	try(single_contour(nds$alpha[,br],nds$beta[,br],col='#555555',lwd=1.5))
	text(mean(nds$alpha[,br]),mean(nds$beta[,br]),paste('Bird',br),font=2,adj=c(0.5,-1.35),cex=0.75)
}
abline(v=0,lty='33',col='#dd0000')
abline(h=1,lty='33',col='#dd0000')
# Marginal BIAS
par(tck=-0.05)
plot(NULL,xlim=lims_bias,ylim=c(0,60),ann=F,axes=F)
axis(1,labels=NA);box()
for(br in 1:length(unique(bird))){
	brks <- seq(-0.05,.25,length.out=80)
	ht <- hist(nds$alpha[,br],breaks=brks,plot=F)
	val <- which(ht$dens>0.01)
	lines(ht$mids[val],ht$dens[val],lwd=1.5,col='#999999')
}
abline(v=0,lty='33',col='#dd0000')
# Marginal SENSITIVITY
plot(NULL,xlim=c(0,60),ylim=lims_sensi,ann=F,axes=F)
axis(2,labels=F);box()
for(br in 1:length(unique(bird))){
	#brks <- seq(0.45,1.4,length.out=80)
	brks <- seq(0,2,length.out=160)
	ht <- hist(nds$beta[,br],breaks=brks,plot=F)
	val <- which(ht$dens>0.01)
	lines(ht$dens[val],
				ht$mids[val],
				lwd=1.5,col='#999999')
}
abline(h=1,lty='33',col='#dd0000')
dev.off()
```
